Maya (PM): Quick kickoff  want to run a 6-week microcohort for design partners focused on latency and realistic launch criteria. Need a short recruit form + clear prioritization rules. Thoughts?
Ibrahim (Growth): Short form only. Prefer sequencing: inbound first, then handpicked enterprise.
Sofia (Design): Screener: 4 fields max + one checkbox: 'Are you able to share anonymized logs for debugging?'
Evan (Solutions Eng): Add a small priority matrix: customer signal (1-5), product fit (1-5), engineering lift (1-5). Accept if score >=12.
Maya (PM): Let's also weight customer signal x1.5 when it's a revenue prospect.
Priya (Legal): Consent required if logs are shared. I'll provide a 2-line consent blurb and default retention to 30 days.
Tess (SRE): Ops constraint: we can offer a rotating dedicated slot (max 3 partners total) but need a fallback plan documented. I'll draft fallback steps.
invite-bot: scheduled post: microcohort-invite-form v1 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (Growth): Incentives: credit + product feedback session. Offer case-study as optional.
Sofia (Design): I'll make a compact onboarding checklist card for accepted partners.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Onboarding gates proposal: (1) >=6 qualified signups; (2) 2 staging integrations validated; (3) no more than one P1 during cohort.
Maya (PM): Action owners: Ibrahim = form+tracking, Sofia = onboarding card, Evan = scoring doc, Tess = fallback runbook, Priya = consent copy. I'll collate into a one-pager by Thu EOD.
